issue_context.title: TestStressingCascadingDeletion is flaky
issue_context.body:
**Which jobs are flaking**:
pull-kubernetes-integration

**Which test(s) are flaking**:
TestStressingCascadingDeletion

**Testgrid link**:
https://prow.k8s.io/view/gcs/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/89019/pull-kubernetes-integration/1237494932579553283

**Reason for failure**:
Maybe related:
```
    garbage_collector_test.go:556: timed out waiting for the condition
```

**Anything else we need to know**:
- links to go.k8s.io/triage appreciated
- links to specific failures in spyglass appreciated
comments: post-submit failures (all of these are flakes): https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#integration-master&width=5&include-filter-by-regex=TestStressingCascadingDeletion
first failure seen in postsubmit is 5708511499fe500ae3b4bbd40204cef382f652e8, part of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/88708 ... preceeding many runs looked clean

I verified the delete options as seen by the server are identical [at this point](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/34ad7d198472a7f4efc3181391ee21294447e2f6/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/endpoints/handlers/delete.go#L121) before and after #88708, so I don't think it is a functional change related to that PR
notably, many other tests in this suite started flaking on 3/7 and after (https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#integration-master&width=5&sort-by-failures=)

figured it out, https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/88708/files#diff-71e62caa4db77f62b62feb4951fd7ca8L464-L466 dropped the detection of empty deletion options which would trigger the test to wait for all pods to be observed by the GC controller

review_comments: what about just moving this to the end of the switch?
I was trying to keep it in the same location to minimize the logical diff from before
